title: Align contributors on design before implementation
statement: As a change author, I can explain the intended experience and system behavior before implementation, so that contributors share a clear direction and reviewers can connect design choices to requirements.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An author can connect user-experience design to the requirement it addresses.
An author can connect technical design to the requirement it addresses.
An addressable design element can identify the acceptance criterion it addresses.
Design can be reviewed before implementation evidence exists.
Changing a linked requirement marks the design relationship stale.
A reader can open the linked requirement from its design.
A reader can open the linked design from its requirement.
